talent.tal_survivor.title: Last Stand
talent.tal_survivor.description: When strength runs low, a tough body and a precise shot carry the day.

quest.qst_story_01_cordon.title: From Beyond the Cordon
quest.qst_story_01_cordon.desc: Scout the area: clear four places (not roads) and return to the hub.
quest.qst_story_02_job.title: A Simple Job
quest.qst_story_02_job.desc: Kill two bandits, open a stash and inspect five loot objects.
quest.qst_story_03_dogs.title: Dogs Beyond the Perimeter
quest.qst_story_03_dogs.desc: Shoot ten wolves beyond the perimeter.
quest.qst_side_medic_mutants.title: Thin the Herd
quest.qst_side_medic_mutants.desc: Kill twenty mutants so people stop being afraid.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.root: Hey. Nobody has come from beyond the cordon in a long time. Hungry? Everything costs here, brother, but I'll give you a start. You need to find your bearings. Go look around and come back to me.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.opt.s1_hard: I'm not your brother. And I don't need handouts.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s1_question: The area. Not the roads — nothing to see there. Yards, forest, abandoned buildings. Four places you visited and left alive. Come back and the raid counts as a success.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.opt.ifdead: What if I don't come back?
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s1_ifdead: Then I'll have to find someone else. But come back. I don't need heroes, I need the living.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s1_accept_st: Good. Take the stew and water — enough for a start. Four places, not roads. Come back alive and you get ammo and medicine.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s1_accept_ha: Feisty. Fine, I'll still give you food so you don't starve on the way. But the work doubles: eight places, not four. Don't argue.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s1_decline: As you wish. Just don't think too long — I won't hold your place in line.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s1_active: Too early. Four places first — not roads. Then we talk.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s1_ready: So, did you look around? Heh, this isn't a walk around town.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s1_reward: Here. Ammo and a medkit. Don't lose them.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s1_reward_ha: Stubborn. I like that — you live longer. Here, you earned it.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s2_offer: Got a job. Easy if you use your head. Two bandits hang around the old road. They have a stash — I need the stash, the bodies are yours. While you're out, inspect five spots: crates, backpacks, whatever you find. Maybe something interesting turns up.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.opt.s2_quest: What if they spot me first?
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.opt.s2_rude: Two bandits? Is that all you can manage?
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s2_question: Then shoot first. Or did you think I feed you for nothing?
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s2_accept_te: Then don't drag it out. The faster you finish, the faster you get paid.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s2_accept_ha: Brave, huh. Then four bandits, two stashes and ten spots. Let's see how brave you are.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s2_decline: As you wish. The job isn't urgent, but it won't wait forever.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s2_active: Stash first, talk later. And don't forget the five spots — I'm counting.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.opt.s2_rewar: I do. And the bandits are gone.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s2_reward: Good. Take the ammo, don't walk around with an empty magazine. And don't ask where the bandits got all that.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s2_reward_ha: Both stashes. Not bad. Here, as agreed.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s3_offer: Hear them howling beyond the perimeter? That's not the wind. The dogs have grown bold, they come to the trails. Help me shoot a dozen — people will breathe easier.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.opt.s3_rude: Why me? Has everyone here forgotten how to use a gun?
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s3_question: Do it first, then we'll haggle. I won't cheat you.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s3_accept_te: Good. Just don't play hero. A dead rookie is no use to me.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s3_accept_ha: Because you're new and you need to prove you're worth feeding. Twenty. Don't come back until you're done.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s3_decline: As you wish. But they won't wait for you to make up your mind.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s3_active: Still howling. Hear it? Come back when they go quiet.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s3_reward: Good. Here. And don't go beyond the perimeter without need.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s3_reward_ha: Twenty. Stubborn. Here, you earned it.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_medic.root: Come in, don't stand in the doorway. Help with the dogs first, then we'll talk.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_medic.opt.refuse: You need it — you do it.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_medic.m1_accept: Thank you. And take care of yourself — I'll have to patch you up later.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_medic.m1_money: Medkits, ammo, a little money. Not more than the Smuggler promises, but I treat the wounded for free.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_medic.m1_refuse: As you wish. But people are afraid, and that won't pass by itself.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_medic.m1_decline: As you wish. But people are afraid, and that won't pass by itself.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_medic.m1_active: Twenty is not five. Go, I'll wait.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_medic.m1_ready: You're back. And by the look of you, not empty-handed.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_medic.m1_reward: Twenty. Good. People are already going beyond the perimeter. Take what I promised.

quest.qst_story_04_atp.desc: Clear the five-location ATP chain and take the flash drive from Muravey.

actor.npc_atp_shustry.name: Muravey
actor.npc_atp_shustry.desc: A strange man who knows more about the ATP than he says.
item.itm_atp_flash.name: ATP Flash Drive
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s4_offer: Now for real work. There's a place — the old ATP beyond the old road. A gang has settled there, and rumour says not only a gang. I need one thing from there. Find it — good. If not, at least clear the place so my people can pass.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s4_thing: A flash drive. Or a disk, whatever they have. I need data, not hardware. There should be a man at the ATP — Muravey. He knows where it is. Find him and talk. And don't go in there without ammo.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s4_shustry: A strange type. He was at the ATP before the gang came. Says little, knows much. If he's alive — find him.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s4_money: Two thousand. And access to goods I don't show everyone.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s4_why: Because I have a shop here and you have young legs. And because you're not new to this anymore.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s4_accept: Don't let me down. And if you see Muravey — don't shoot right away. Talk first.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s4_decline: As you wish. But know this: there won't be another job like it.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s4_active: Clear the ATP first. Then we'll talk.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s4_ready: The ATP is clear. What do you have?
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s4_reward_fl: So Muravey is alive. Good. I thought he was long gone. Here, as agreed.
dialog.dlg_npc_atp_shustry.root: Quiet! Don't make noise. There are five of them, maybe more. I'm Muravey. They locked me in here. Help me clear the ATP and I'll tell you where the thing your boss wants is.
dialog.dlg_npc_atp_shustry.opt.done: It's clear. Give me the flash drive.
dialog.dlg_npc_atp_shustry.who: I've lived here longer than these freaks. They came, took everything they could, and left me guarding their junk.
dialog.dlg_npc_atp_shustry.where: At the checkpoint, in the yard, in the garage and in the barracks. Their boss, a mercenary, is in dispatch. The rest first, then him. And don't get yourself killed.
dialog.dlg_npc_atp_shustry.flash: Clear the ATP first, then the flash drive. I'm not suicidal.
dialog.dlg_npc_atp_shustry.after_clear: That's it. The ATP is clear. Take it, this is what you're looking for. Tell the Smuggler there's nobody here anymore.
dialog.dlg_npc_atp_shustry.what: Data. Not your business — give it to your boss.
quest.qst_story_05_angar.title: New Connections
quest.qst_story_05_angar.desc: Reach the Depot and talk to Gvozd.
location.depot.title: Depot
spawn.angar.gvozd.title: Gvozd
actor.npc_angar_gvozd.name: Gvozd
actor.npc_angar_gvozd.desc: The owner of the scrapyard depot. Speaks plainly, helps only after he trusts you.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s5_offer: You've proven yourself, which means you won't die tomorrow. I recommended you to a friend of mine. He lives at the scrapyard, runs a depot. Go to him. Tell him I sent you.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s5_where: Leave the Settlement and follow the old road. The scrapyard is beyond it. You'll see the depot yourself.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s5_who: Gvozd. A decent man if you don't anger him. Don't expect him to like you right away — prove you're worth something first.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s5_accept: Tell him I haven't forgotten. He'll understand.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s5_decline: As you wish. But a chance like this doesn't come to everyone.
dialog.dlg_trd_hub_smuggler.s5_active: Go to Gvozd. I warned him, he's waiting.
dialog.dlg_angar_gvozd.root: Stop. Who are you?.. Ah, from the Smuggler. He warned me. Fine, come in since you're here.
dialog.dlg_angar_gvozd.opt.rest: I need a place to rest.
dialog.dlg_angar_gvozd.opt.rude: Too much honour — standing on the doorstep.
dialog.dlg_angar_gvozd.help: Maybe I can. But first let's see what kind of person you are. I have work — and not the same as his.
dialog.dlg_angar_gvozd.rest: Rest? This isn't an inn. But if you're useful, a corner will be found.
dialog.dlg_angar_gvozd.rude: Cocky. Fine, come in. Let's see how long that lasts.
dialog.dlg_angar_gvozd.s5_ready: So you made it. The Smuggler didn't lie — you're worth your bread. Welcome to the Depot. This isn't the Settlement: different rules, different people. But if you're useful, you won't go hungry.
dialog.dlg_angar_gvozd.next_chapter: Come back tomorrow. Today I want to see how you settle in.
